title: Super Pi global settings
description: Editor assistance for ~/.sp/agent/config/settings.json. All fields are optional. This schema does not change runtime loading, migration or trust decisions.

$schema.description: Editor schema URL or local file reference.

lastChangelogVersion.description: Last changelog version shown; maintained by Super Pi.

lastUpdateNotificationVersion.description: Last update notification version; maintained by Super Pi.

defaultProvider.description: Default provider identifier, including custom providers.

defaultModel.description: Default model identifier within the selected provider.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: Default reasoning effort; availability depends on the model.

modelThinkingLevels.description: Per-model reasoning defaults keyed by provider/modelId.

steeringMode.description: How queued steering messages are delivered.

followUpMode.description: How queued follow-up messages are delivered.

theme.description: Theme name or automatic light/dark theme pair separated by /.

compaction.description: Automatic context compaction. Nested fields inherit from global settings in projects.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the next response.

keepRecentTokens.description: Recent tokens to retain after compaction.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the prompt and summary response.

skipPrompt.description: Skip the summary prompt and default to no summary.

retry.description: Agent-level retry policy and provider request overrides.

maxDelayMs.description: Legacy alias migrated to retry.provider.maxRetryDelayMs when not already configured.

maxRetryDelayMs.description: Maximum server-requested retry delay before failing.

hideThinkingBlock.description: Hide reasoning blocks in the transcript.

showCacheMissNotices.description: Show notices for significant prompt-cache misses.

externalEditor.description: Ctrl+G editor command; takes precedence over VISUAL/EDITOR.

shellPath.description: Custom bash-compatible shell executable; supports leading ~ expansion.

powershellPath.description: Global-only PowerShell executable override. Project settings cannot redirect it.

powershellStatus.description: Global-only PowerShell discovery state maintained by Super Pi.

available.description: Whether PowerShell is offered without an explicit re-enable.

verified.description: Whether a command or probe confirmed the executable.

configuredPath.description: Explicit path in effect when discovery ran.

defaultProjectTrust.description: Global-only default for project trust. Projects cannot grant themselves trust.

npmCommand.description: npm launcher as argv, for example [mise, exec, node@20, --, npm].

collapseChangelog.description: Show a condensed changelog after updates.

enableInstallTelemetry.description: Enable the anonymous version/update ping after a changelog-detected update.

enableAnalytics.description: Opt in to analytics data sharing.

trackingId.description: Analytics identifier generated when analytics is enabled.

packages.description: Package sources, optionally with resource filters and autoload control.

skills.description: Local skill paths, or a legacy skills object migrated when loaded.

enableSkillCommands.description: Legacy alias for the top-level enableSkillCommands setting.

customDirectories.description: Legacy skill directories migrated to the skills array.

prompts.description: Local prompt template paths or directories.

showImages.description: Show images when the terminal supports them.

imageWidthCells.description: Preferred inline image width in cells.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear rows when content shrinks; otherwise SP_CLEAR_ON_SHRINK controls the default.

autoResize.description: Resize images to fit within 2000 by 2000 pixels.

blockImages.description: Prevent images from being sent to providers.

toolResultPresentation.description: Opt-in bounded tool-result presentation. When enabled, the merged effective settings must provide a positive safe-integer budgetTokens; a project may inherit that budget.

budgetTokens.description: Explicit token budget. No production default is selected.

enabledModels.description: Model patterns for cycling, using the --models syntax.

defaultTools.description: Initial built-in tool selection; does not disable extension or SDK tools.

doubleEscapeAction.description: Action for double Escape with an empty editor.

thinkingBudgets.description: Custom token budgets for supported reasoning levels.

showHardwareCursor.description: Show the terminal cursor instead of the focused fake cursor; IME positioning is retained. Defaults to SP_HARDWARE_CURSOR=1.

anthropicExtraUsage.description: Show Anthropic extra-usage warnings where applicable.

sessionDir.description: Session storage directory, using the --session-dir path syntax.

httpProxy.description: Global-only proxy URL used by startup when HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY are not already set.

httpIdleTimeoutMs.description: HTTP header/body idle timeout in milliseconds; 0 disables it.

websocketConnectTimeoutMs.description: WebSocket connection handshake timeout in milliseconds; 0 disables it. Otherwise provider defaults apply.

fullscreenExitOutput.description: What remains after exiting fullscreen mode.

queueMode.description: Legacy alias migrated to steeringMode when steeringMode is absent.

websockets.description: Legacy transport selector: true becomes websocket, false becomes sse when transport is absent.

timeout.description: Non-negative milliseconds. Legacy numeric strings and case-insensitive disabled are also accepted; fractional values are rounded down at runtime.

source.description: npm, git or local package source.

autoload.description: When false, load only explicitly selected resource patterns.
